meta.name: react-expert
meta.description: Use when building React 18+ applications in .jsx or .tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Creates components, implements custom hooks, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and implements state management. Invoke for Server Components, Suspense boundaries, useActionState forms, performance optimization, or React 19 features.

copy.tagline_en: Build React components, custom hooks, and optimize rendering performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building frontend apps with React 18+ or Next.js

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写 React 组件、自定义 Hook、处理状态管理、优化性能，并迁移旧代码到新写法。
howto.when: 当你提到 React、JSX、hooks、Server Components 等关键词，或要求创建组件、实现表单、调试渲染问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 19 的 useActionState 表单组件。
优化这个列表组件的渲染性能。
say.note: Claude 会分析并应用 memo、lazy 等优化。

say.text: 把这个类组件改写成函数组件加 hooks。
say.note: Claude 会进行迁移并确保类型正确。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write React components, custom hooks, manage state, optimize performance, and migrate legacy code to modern patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention React, JSX, hooks, Server Components, or ask to create components, implement forms, or debug rendering issues.

say_en.text: Write a React 19 form using useActionState.
Optimize the rendering performance of this list component.
Convert this class component to a functional component with hooks.
say_en.note: Claude migrates and ensures type safety.
